name: army
description: A chief of staff that commands 18 specialist units as subagents, plus 8 drills you can run on their own: put a decision on trial, admit a bug, let critics taste the work, go/no-go a release, examine a skill, recall past records, write the release edition, and claim lanes for parallel sessions. 110+ on-demand playbooks, cost-aware model routing, safety gates and local memory.
